conf.description: DMARC aggregate (rua) per-row JSON from parsedmarc: epoch date_begin/date_end to RFC 3339 with _time from date_end (not arrival time), passed_dmarc to event.outcome, message_count kept as a custom volume field never folded into event.*, drop _raw per recommendations.direct.cribl since the feed has no forensic value beyond its parsed fields.

conf.comment: dmarc-reports / aggregate / json. parsedmarc is the collector (mailbox poll + XML parse + fan-out), not a Cribl/Elastic pack -- no dmarc integration exists anywhere, so every field is hand-mapped. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: _time/@timestamp derives from date_end, never parse-time, since reports arrive 24-48h after the window they describe. message_count is the unit of volume (one row = N messages), kept off event.* so nothing double-counts it. Three parsedmarc output shapes are normalised onto per-row names first (see the unroll and code steps); the dotted vendor names (published_policy.domain, policy_overrides.type, dkim_results.result, spf_results.result) are treated as literal flat keys with a dot, not nested paths -- bracket read, not rename (see README, assumption pending a real sample). source_country's alpha-2-vs-full-name variance is split heuristically by length, no GeoIP lookup here. _raw dropped per the recommendation.

functions.description: record approach, flat-vs-nested dotted-key decision, and rationale
parse the per-row JSON document parsedmarc ships to the collector
parsedmarc's per-report JSON (its JSON file output) carries every record in records[]: one event per record, report fields copied

Normalise the three parsedmarc shapes - per-report JSON (unrolled above), Kafka per-record slices (nested source/alignment/... plus policy_published and date_range) and Splunk HEC per-row events (flat source_*, nested published_policy, dkim/spf result lists) - onto the per-row names this map reads; epoch dates from the record interval, else the report window. Nothing already present is overwritten.

derived/computed fields read from ORIGINAL vendor names before the rename batch: epoch timestamp conversions, passed_dmarc/country lookups, flat-dotted-key bracket reads for the policy/dkim/spf sub-fields
batch every clean flat-key status:mapped/unmapped field with no further transform
delete every now-consumed original key plus _raw (dropped per recommendations.direct.cribl -- no forensic value beyond the parsed fields)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
